analysis: B2 fresh-query matched systems and CG-ICS search budgets
accuracy_estimand: Mean IoU over three distinct references per query-target, then equal query-target mean within dataset. All four configurations cover identical exact inputs. 100 query images per fold.
bootstrap_scope: Query-image cluster percentile bootstrap, with all references paired; fixed-fold stratification is a separately labelled sensitivity. Exploratory, no multiplicity correction, one model seed.
cost_estimand: Same recorded runner GPU model and exact query/reference inputs only; ratio of arithmetic mean inference_seconds. Each stratum reports accuracy on its own matched-input subset. Startup, contention and MLLM GPU model are not controlled by runner matching.
cost_limitations: INSID3 allocates one GPU; CG-ICS variants allocate two including the owned MLLM. Runner-time ratios are not total GPU-efficiency ratios.
No cross-GPU pooled speedup is reported. Different strata may have different query/fold composition.
Memory values are sampled owned-process simultaneous peaks and include vLLM reserved/cache memory, not minimum model requirements.
Worker cost records refer to exported current attempts; they do not establish total historical retry/queue cost.
BON1 changes initial candidate budget to one while retaining full-search expansion/restarts; it is not the single-concept no-search route.

insid3_full.note: Exported canonical and archived records only; absence of archived errors does not prove no historical scheduler/infrastructure failures.
